mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, sports_meeting_id, create_time, update_time FROM notice WHERE sports_meeting_id IS NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, title, content, sports_meeting_id, create_time, update_time FROM notice WHERE sports_meeting_id = #{sportsMeetingId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, sports_meeting_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{sportsMeetingId})
